t: The Titan rechargeable LED Work Light delivers powerful, portable illumination for trade professionals. Providing a bright 2200 lumens with a crisp 6500K daylight colour temperature, this work light is suitable for both outdoor construction sites and indoor workshops. Its robust IP65 rating ensures water resistance and durability in demanding environments. Consistent lighting quality is maintained by a constant lumen output across the battery discharge curve. The adjustable head allows precise light positioning, complemented by 3-step dimming to adapt brightness to the task. An integrated power bank with a USB-A port conveniently charges mobile devices on site. This versatile site lighting solution features a folding stand and carry handle for easy placement and transport.
